blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States — OpenAI has rattled the quiet world of mathematics by using artificial intelligence to solve a major, century-old problem, raising the question of what role mathematicians will play in scientific research going forward. Earlier this month, thousands of its AI agents worked together to solve the Navier-Stokes equations — which generations of mathematicians have tried to tackle — in a matter of four days. UCLA professor Terence Tao, who has won the elite Fields Medal recognizing the world’s most esteemed mathematicians, told AFP: “I am currently completely overwhelmed with an existential crisis in my field.” READ: The […]...
